package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"

	_ "github.com/lib/pq"
)

// scenario for sql_open_per_request: database/sql pools opened on request paths instead of process-level setup.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

func scenario298Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	db, err := sql.Open("postgres", "host=localhost dbname=app sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "db connection failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer db.Close()

	var count int
	row := db.QueryRow("SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE active = true")
	if err := row.Scan(&count); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "query failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
